sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair applicability and ownership: do not attach the StructuralMemberShape unconditionally to every hasStructuralMember value, since it makes the four section alternatives and both dimensional inputs mandatory for non-applicable members. Enforce inputs and the bounded formula only for members selected by a valid applicable section type. Use a canonical flat-bar controlled value compatible with structuralSectionType: the supplied flatBarSection has range frameProfileTypeValue, not structuralSectionTypeValue, so locate the appropriate missing canonical value.
